name: Deep Agents + LangGraph
strength: Auditable research, planning, subagents and human approval
limits: Requires building an application and configuring persistence, scheduling and tool boundaries.
cost: $0 self-hosted license; model/API, optional LangSmith and infrastructure costs.
free: SDK has no published agent-seat quota; managed hosting, traces and deployment have separate plan limits.

name: OpenClaw
strength: Messaging, scheduled jobs, multi-agent identities and broad integrations
limits: Sandboxing is not on by default; tool/plugin trust and gateway hardening require deliberate setup.
deployment: Official Docker Compose gateway; validate sandbox separately
cost: $0 self-hosted license; model/API and optional integrations.
free: No published local seat quota; integrations, model access and infrastructure are bring-your-own.

name: Hermes Agent
strength: Persistent memory, reusable evolving skills, terminal tools and subagents
limits: Self-modifying skills and terminal actions need review; Docker execution backend may require privileged daemon access if configured carelessly.
deployment: Official documented container route; validate isolation before enabling terminal tools
cost: $0 MIT self-hosted software; model/API or optional Nous Portal.
free: Local software is not constrained by Nous hosted subscription quotas; paid hosted model/tool access is separate.

name: Pi (coding agent)
strength: Small extensible coding-agent core, skills, TypeScript extensions and multiple providers
limits: No native multi-agent organization or cron control plane; must implement extra automation and security boundaries.
deployment: Build small Node container around CLI/SDK
free: No published seat cap; advanced orchestration is DIY.

name: Letta
strength: Cross-session memory, agent state and memory evaluation
limits: Self-hosting requires services/storage; cloud free quotas differ from self-hosted capabilities.
deployment: Official self-hosted app server after docs check
cost: $0 self-hosted software plus inference/hosting; optional paid cloud.
free: Cloud Free has usage and memory limits; verify current pricing before use.

name: CrewAI
limits: Schedules, durable memory and external tool security need configuration.
cost: Open-source framework $0; models and optional managed services cost extra.
free: Self-hosted framework vs managed-platform limits differ; verify before purchase.

name: n8n
strength: Triggers, approvals, integrations and visual automation
limits: Not a direct autonomous-agent harness; license is source-available/fair-code, not unrestricted OSS.
cost: Self-hosted community edition no license charge; hosting and optional cloud plans.
free: Community edition lacks some enterprise features; licensing limits certain commercial uses.

name: Paperclip
strength: Agent assignments, governance, budget monitoring and adapter coordination
limits: Not itself a model runtime; adapters and agent execution environments are additional.
deployment: Follow repository install guide; isolate adapters
free: No verified self-hosted task quota; cloud pricing and capabilities can change.
